heading: top-left
name: 靠左標題＋圖片卡片網格＋置中按鈕
desc: 上方靠左只有一個標題，下方是等寬等高的圖片卡片網格，圖片左上角疊小標籤，網格下方置中一顆按鈕；手機改為邊緣露出下一張的輪播。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組只有一個標題（可多行），不放小標籤與說明文字；標題明顯大於項目的標題。標題組下方是網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機只有一列，約四個等寬項目並排，不換到第二列，項目等高。每個項目是一張無邊框的卡片：上方是橫式圖片，貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側，所有圖片同一比例；圖片左上角可疊放少數幾個橫向並排的小標籤，沒有時省略；圖片下方是有底色的文字區，標題（可多行）置中、靠文字區上方，下方留大片空白。網格下方置中可放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，仍只有一列，一列的項目數量減少。
mobile: 網格改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一張卡片，約佔畫面寬的八成以上並靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一張卡片的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣。整個輪播只有一組左右箭頭按鈕，不是每張卡片各一組：兩個小箭頭固定在輪播的左右兩緣、約在圖片的垂直中央，右箭頭壓在露出的下一張卡片上；切換時箭頭位置不變。標題改為置中。卡片內的組成不變，按鈕仍在輪播下方置中。

en.name: Left-aligned title + image card grid + centered button
en.desc: A single title aligned left at the top, followed by a grid of equal-width, equal-height image cards with labels overlaid on the top-left of each image, and one centered button below the grid; on mobile it becomes a carousel with part of the next card showing.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains only a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with no label or description. The title is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group is a grid aligned to the page content width; on desktop it has only a single row of about four equal-width items side by side, never wrapping to a second row, and the items are equal in height. Each item is a card without a border: at the top is a landscape image, flush with the top edge and both sides of the card, with all images in the same proportion; optionally overlay a few labels side by side on the top-left of the image, omitted when there is no content; below the image is a text area with a background color, where the title (may wrap to multiple lines) is centered near the top of the text area, leaving a large empty space below it. Optionally place one button centered below the grid; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, still with a single row but fewer items in it.
en.mobile: The grid becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one card is visible at a time, taking more than about eighty percent of the screen width and aligned left with the page content width, while part of the next card shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. The whole carousel has only one pair of left and right arrow icon buttons, not one pair per card: the two small arrows stay fixed at the left and right edges of the carousel, roughly at the vertical center of the images, with the right arrow overlapping the partly visible next card; the arrows do not move when switching. The title becomes centered. The composition of each card stays the same, and the button stays centered below the carousel.
